description: Historical pull requests a maintainer already decided, for replaying the review agent (#36). accept: merged after approval with no changes requested, judged as merged. rework: a review that requested changes on a pull request that later merged, judged as the reviewer saw it at that commit. reject: closed unmerged by a maintainer after a review that declined the change on its merits. Excluded on purpose: pull requests declined for how they were written (the '[rejected AI]' closures), closures that were abandonment rather than a decision, bot updates, and reviews that only praised. Each case keeps the URL of the decision it is labelled with.
